description: InterWeave's rules for runtime/github/arm.sh. boundary.paths is InterWeave CLAUDE.md's security-boundary list — identity and key handling, trust policy, wire or configuration parsing, persistence, admission and resource accounting, and anything cryptographic — in path form, matched case-insensitively. Whole crates where the crate is the boundary: identity, every api/ contract crate (wire shapes and validation), config parsing, the local IPC server and client, the transport stack, the human chat protocol, store and transport client, the two transport apps, and the vendored third_party/ code. Words where the boundary is a file anywhere: key, trust, crypt, sign, noise, tls, cipher, parse, codec, wire, protocol, persist, store, admission, quota, accounting, limit. Over-matching costs a review; under-matching costs a boundary. The wire contracts, architecture/contracts/, are on it whole — a schema is the wire (#171 flipped one with no crate touched). boundary.exempt is dropped first: Markdown and architecture/ prose outside the contracts, tools/, xtask/, .github/, .claude/ and .agent-fabric/ — documentation and mechanical changes are not on the list. No classes: InterWeave arms under eight work commits only on the owner's word (CLAUDE.md §9). Declared by devex-tooling.
